program_name: Turner & Townsend — Graduate Development Programme 2026 (Quantity Survey - Vietnam)

levels.chua_dat: Below the program's academic standard (Degree in quantity surveying, construction management, engineering or equivalent Fresh graduates / graduates with maximum 2 years working experience are preferred) or the CV does not clearly state GPA/major.
levels.dat: Degree in quantity surveying, construction management, engineering or equivalent Fresh graduates / graduates with maximum 2 years working experience are preferred
levels.noi_bat: GPA ~8.5/10 (3.5/4.0) or above, scholarship or top departmental ranking; major closely matches the applied track, or holds a double degree/supplementary professional certificate.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no evidence of English proficiency (certificate, English-medium program, English-speaking work environment). Program standard: Good command of written and spoken English.
levels.dat: Good command of written and spoken English.
levels.noi_bat: IELTS 7.0+/TOEIC 900+ or has studied/worked entirely in English; confident presenting, debating cases, and interviewing on a panel in English.

levels.chua_dat: No leadership role shown: only a club member, or the CV shows no meaningful extracurricular activity.
levels.dat: At least one leader/lead-organizer role in a club, project, or event — with a concrete description of what was actually done.
levels.noi_bat: Club president / lead organizer of a large-scale event / project founder — with measurable results (team size led, budget scale, growth achieved).

levels.chua_dat: No internship/work experience relevant to: Knowledge of main cost management concepts, tools and techniques
levels.dat: Knowledge of main cost management concepts, tools and techniques
levels.noi_bat: Two or more relevant internships, or one internship with a measurable achievement (KPI hit, project actually shipped) at a company in the same industry as Turner & Townsend.

levels.chua_dat: No evidence of analytical thinking: no quantitative coursework, data project, or case-practice experience.
levels.dat: Has an analytical foundation (quantitative coursework, strong Excel, prior case practice) — enough to pass the program's assessment/aptitude test.
levels.noi_bat: Case competition achievements or a real analytical project + solid tools (advanced Excel, SQL/Python if the track needs it) — ready for both aptitude tests and assessment centres.

levels.chua_dat: CV does not mention any award, scholarship, or competition.
levels.dat: Has taken part in an academic/case competition or won a school-level scholarship/award.
levels.noi_bat: Reached the final rounds or won a major competition (case competitions in the relevant industry, national hackathon/datathon) or a national-level scholarship/award.

levels.chua_dat: CV shows no genuine interest signal or motivation tied to Turner & Townsend or its industry; generic application reasons only.
levels.dat: Ability to work in a fast paced and high pressure environment as part of a committed team. Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
levels.noi_bat: A clear, specific story connecting personal motivation, prior projects, and understanding of Turner & Townsend's business/brand/values in Vietnam.

ideal_profile_text:
Degree in quantity surveying, construction management, engineering or equivalent
Fresh graduates / graduates with maximum 2 years working experience are preferred
Knowledge of main cost management concepts, tools and techniques 
Ability to work in a fast paced and high pressure environment as part of a committed team. 
Excellent communication and negotiation skills. 
Good command of written and spoken English.
